topic: Review: Git commit range 0039903bde..HEAD on branch worktrees/113-rem-onboarding-fixes: commits dd001838f0, 54a2e9abbc, 424f28b8fc. Before reviewing, read .skilled/agents/deep-review.md (your agent definition) and follow it as your persona. Inspect with: git log --oneline 0039903bde..HEAD ; git show --stat <sha> ; git diff 0039903bde..HEAD -- <path>. What the commits did, from research recommendations R1, R2 and R4 to R11 in specs/sk-code/011-sk-code-poinytail-based-refinement/020-open-ends-research/002-fresh-clone-onboarding/research/research.md section 11: (1) README Quick Start: Node 24.x prerequisite line, removed the false claim that the advisor launcher builds its own runtime, new step 3 spec-kit build, advisor step ordering note, step 5 git config skilled.trustRepoHooks, First Use names all seven runtimes; CONTRIBUTING Node line. (2) Pi session-start extension warns naming npm --prefix .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit run build when the built session-prime adapter is missing. (3) Codex default hook drift message names the spec-kit runtime build; .codex/hooks.json regenerated by sync-hook-registrations.cjs. (4) sk-vision SKILL.md states the Bun prerequisite and bun install && bun run build setup. (5) The agent mirror checker exits 3 (NOT CHECKABLE) when the built frontmatter parser is missing, and both pre-commit hooks warn and skip on exit 3 while still blocking other non-zero exits. (6) Version bumps system-spec-kit 2.7.11.0 and sk-vision 0.3.6.0 with changelog entries; Hermes skill copies regenerated. Check: correctness of each claim the README makes against the code (commands, paths, runtime command spellings per .codex/.cursor/.pi/.hermes/.devin SYNC.md files), shell correctness of the hook edits under set -euo pipefail, whether exit 3 could collide with another meaning, whether the Pi notice can misfire, test quality (each new test fails before and passes after), security of any new path handling, and prevent-overengineering per .skilled/repo-rules/prevent-overengineering.md. Out of scope: .claude/settings.json (operator decision keeps it unchanged); the CONTRIBUTING validate_document missing-overview error predates these commits.
